objective: 自动化本地模型执行、分主机部署、发布证据与可复现的性能测量，同时不削弱机器人安全边界，也不虚构人工与硬件证据。
acceptance: a localhost-only model runner invokes a real Ollama-compatible API and validates the returned TaskGraph before use
offline template mode remains deterministic and both runner modes have behavior tests
one analysis path reports stage P50/P95 for simulation and hardware-shaped telemetry without treating fixtures as hardware evidence
startup and per-process CPU/RAM benchmarks emit machine-readable evidence with explicit environment metadata
controller and simulation services have independently deployable configurations and fail readiness when their peer is unavailable
release automation publishes an immutable image digest, SPDX SBOM, provenance manifest, and verification instructions
cold-start and hardware evidence collection is automated but remains incomplete until real participants or hardware provide records
evidence: 单元测试与集成测试输出
本地模型响应元数据与已验证的语义 TaskGraph
启动阶段与资源 JSON 报告
仿真与硬件遥测分析报告
容器健康检查与分主机部署冒烟测试
发布清单、镜像摘要、SPDX SBOM 与冷启动参与者记录
stop_conditions: 需要修改冻结的接口或契约
模型输出将获得对关节、速度、固件或急停命令的访问
需要发布凭据、人工合并决策或外部参与者
物理硬件证据将需要被推断或虚构
